description: This file is a CMake module script used to locate and configure the bcm_host library within a build system. It defines how to find the bcm_host package, its dependencies, and sets up imported target properties for use in a CMake-based build.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates the specified package, here it's used to find PkgConfig.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the package configuration modules, here for bcm_host.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library, here bcm_host library.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles setting standard variables based on the find results.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported target for bcm_host.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets various properties on the imported target.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks certain variables as advanced in CMake GUIs.
